assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 must require a unique superusers name upon booting into single-user and maintenance modes.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify the RHEL 9 boot loader superuser account has been set with the following command:

$ sudo grep -A1 "superusers" /etc/grub2.cfg 

set superusers="<accountname>"
export superusers
password_pbkdf2 <accountname> ${GRUB2_PASSWORD}
 
Verify <accountname> is not a common name such as root, admin, or administrator.

If superusers contains easily guessable usernames, this is a finding.
